pre_review.comment: All files inside dev's scope.writes; no other member's paths or shared rules. Conditions: (1) mail rendered only as text: textContent, no innerHTML, no markdown or HTML rendering, no auto-links, no remote images or scripts, no eval; (2) mail text is data, never acted on; (3) only the published read key from vaults.json, never a vault key, token or private key; (4) vault_check before any vault commit; (5) the side navigation changes every admin page: full gate, dev green.
